primary_analytical_question: How do electricity generation shares and capacity concentrations compare across fuel types, U.S. states (2018-2024), and global grid regions, and which high-capacity facilities currently in maintenance represent the largest regional capacity exposure?
decision_to_be_supported: Prioritizing regional grid resilience monitoring and clean-energy transition benchmarking for energy infrastructure analysts.
optional_supporting_track: Track B — Trend Intelligence (U.S. EIA 2018-2024 annual fuel-mix trajectories) & Track C — Risk & Priority Intelligence (maintenance capacity exposure)

track_matrix.evidence: 10 standardized fuel categories, 52 U.S. state/national entities, and 10 global grid regions with complete capacity (MW) and generation (thousand_MWh) metrics.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: None (must stratify by record_type so MW and thousand_MWh are compared within their own populations).

track_matrix.evidence: 1,787 EIA measurement records span 7 ordered annual periods (2018-2024) across U.S. states and fuel types.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: Applies strictly to record_type='measurement' (EIA annual series); the 45 global plant entities are a single 2026 snapshot.
track_matrix.recommendation: Optional Supporting Track (for U.S. annual fuel-mix trends)

track_matrix.evidence: 45 global plants include nameplate capacity (MW), operational status ('online' vs 'maintenance'), and regional concentration.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: Lacks real-time grid load, reserve margin, or outage duration telemetry for dynamic risk scoring.
track_matrix.recommendation: Optional Supporting Track (capacity-at-risk / maintenance exposure ranking)

track_matrix.evidence: Comparable state-level annual generation baselines across 2018-2024 allow year-over-year generation shock detection.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: Annual resolution cannot detect short-term plant outages or intraday grid spikes.

track_matrix.evidence: Multi-dimensional attributes (fuel category, geography, capacity/generation scale, operational status) support interpretable energy-profile grouping.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: Must segment entities and measurements separately.

track_matrix.evidence: Dataset contains annual historical generation aggregates and a static plant snapshot.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: No genuine forecasting target with sub-annual granularity, exogenous weather/demand predictors, or decision-time feature separation; only 7 annual steps exist.
track_matrix.recommendation: Rejected per Predictive Intelligence Approval Checklist

track_matrix.evidence: Records represent observed historical EIA values and static plant capacities.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: No configurable scenario inputs, dispatch constraints, or parameterized simulation runs exist in canonical data.

track_matrix.evidence: text_value consists of deterministic template strings generated during standardization.
track_matrix.missing_requirement: No organic unstructured text corpus (incident logs, operator notes, regulatory filings) exists.

final_result: DATA READY FOR ANALYTICAL TRACK DEVELOPMENT
